display.title: {"text": "Nether Expeditions"}
description: Incendium's castles, sanctums, reactors and labs, YUNG's fortresses, bastions and piglin donjons. Hostile terrain, ranged and fire damage everywhere.
&ePrepare:&r Fire resistance, gold armour piece, blast protection, a bow, a way home.
&eSignature rewards:&r Cinder Idols (exchange for Inferno/Blood Lord/Molten Breach gems), Ancient Cores, bastion treasure hearts (rare).
&eComing back:&r Incendium structures are large and widely spaced; the Nether is 8x faster to travel.
&eFeeds into:&r Idols -> nether gems; cores -> sockets; netherite.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
